releases.name: Mars
releases.description: Combined product release bundling Mercury + Saturn + Guillermo's editor/transcriber workflow + Lyra + Pluto (release-of-releases).
releases.notes: Merged into master (prod branch) + dev + staging. Prod deploy not yet run (no vX.Y.Z tag, deploy-prod.yml not run). Trailing gold-corpus commit 185182cf/PR #527 not yet re-promoted to all envs.

releases.name: Mercury
releases.description: Admin cross-org org management + in-app multi-org (create/close/login-picker) + first-run/billing/security/RBAC hardening.
releases.notes: Merged into all three env branches (own PR #399 + Mars bundle); prod deploy not yet run.

releases.name: Saturn
releases.description: Registration & Subscription Lifecycle Audit remediation (CORE-1165 cluster) — student checkout/subscription, legal/compliance capture, test-coverage, webhook robustness, tenant isolation.
releases.notes: Merged into all three env branches via Mars bundle; prod deploy not yet run.

releases.name: Lyra
releases.description: Shahruk's saltier transcription pipeline (per-job modes, Parakeet ASR, graph config) + async convention-editor AI rewire.
releases.notes: Merged into all three env branches via Mars bundle (release PR #411 merged 2026-06-24); prod deploy not yet run.

releases.name: Pluto
releases.description: Organization Settings refinements — org-admin + site-admin UX fixes (nav->org-switcher, Payment-methods tab + card-on-file, Users tab + license status, Student plan, context Help panel, invite-link & license-count bug fixes).
releases.notes: Merged into all three env branches via Mars bundle (one nix-vendorHash straggler e5074cb9 not re-promoted from the branch tip); prod deploy not yet run.

releases.name: Earth
releases.description: Combined product release bundling Guillermo's in-flight SALT/frontend fixes into one coordinated promotion (functions as a Mars sub-release).
releases.notes: Merged into Mars via a merged PR (integration PR #511 -> jeremy/integration-mars) and Mars is on all three env branches, so Earth is ☑☑☑.

releases.name: Orion
releases.description: Product release following Mars; gathers feature/fix branches that land post-Mars-cut (speaker-caseload ownership scoping, admin release-info page, PHI retention hardening, erasure/retention deletes, IDOR audit sweep, Neptune licensing epic, Magento connector, targeted bug fixes).
releases.notes: In progress — gathering constituents; release/orion cut post-Mars, 11 commits, not yet promoted to any env. Some constituents (CORE-1294, CORE-1298) already landed in the master base via Pluto and ride Orion automatically.

releases.name: Neptune
releases.description: SaaS licensing-model overhaul — phased, multi-workstream epic: user/org dual-ownership licenses, personal-org provisioning, student verification, org-context safeguards, anti-abuse controls. Committed to Orion scope (2026-06-30).
releases.notes: No integration branch cut yet; Phase 0 (ADRs) in review, Phase 1 (foundations) in review, Phase 2 in progress. Phases 3/4b blocked on design-committee escalations #9/#10. Neptune branches currently based on 'saturn' plan and must re-target onto release/orion.

releases.name: Bull
releases.description: Sub-release of Orion: batches post-Mars SALT editor/transcriber + UI fix PRs (#529-#538) onto one integration branch, which promotes into release/orion (not directly into env branches).
releases.notes: All 10 constituent PRs merged into guillermo/integration-bull as of 2026-07-03 (51 commits ahead of origin/master). Bundle -> release/orion PR not yet opened; not yet in any long-lived branch.

releases.name: Rust
releases.description: Redis/Memorystore performance cache release — shared Redis cache for RBAC + feature-flag hot paths (permission-revocation staleness fix; latency + DB-load wins).
releases.notes: Backlog (infra-blocked). Component PRs (spice-rack #299, gcp-infrastructure #43) moved out of draft but integration branch not yet cut.

releases.name: Transcriber Portal 1.1
